snippets.title: Four on the floor
snippets.description: A kick on every beat: the pulse of house and techno.

snippets.title: Broken garage kick
snippets.description: Skip beat 3 and push a kick onto the last 16th of beat 2: the shuffle of UK garage.

snippets.title: Half-time kick
snippets.description: Kicks on 1 and the 'and' of 2 with the snare left for beat 3: the space of trap and half-time dnb.

snippets.title: Two-step (dnb)
snippets.description: Kick on 1 and on the 'and' of 3, snares on 2 and 4 fill the gaps: the drum & bass two-step.

snippets.title: Boom-bap kick
snippets.description: A lazy hip-hop kick on 8ths, swung so the off-beats drag behind.

snippets.title: Driving techno kick
snippets.description: Four on the floor with a little saturation (shape) for weight; keep gain down, shape adds level.

snippets.title: Backbeat clap
snippets.description: Claps on beats 2 and 4, the backbeat almost every groove leans on.

snippets.title: 808 backbeat
snippets.description: Snare on 2 and 4 with a short room, the classic 808 crack.

snippets.title: Ghost notes
snippets.description: Quiet extra snares between the backbeat: stack a loud and a soft layer to make it groove.
snippets.code: stack(s("~ sd ~ sd").gain(0.75), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ sd ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~").gain(0.2)).bank("RolandTR909")

snippets.title: Snare roll build
snippets.description: The last hit splits into 2, 4, then 8 over four bars: a roll that builds into the drop.
snippets.code: s("~ sd ~ <sd [sd sd] [sd sd sd sd] sd*8>").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.65)

snippets.title: Rimshot pattern
snippets.description: A 3-3-2 rimshot figure (euclid 3 of 8) that adds latin lift without a snare.

snippets.title: Straight 8ths
snippets.description: Closed hats on every 8th, the on-beats louder than the off-beats.

snippets.title: Swung 16ths
snippets.description: 16th hats with accents, every second one pushed late by swingBy for a human shuffle.

snippets.title: Off-beat open hat
snippets.description: An open hat between the kicks: the 'tss' of disco and house (cut stops each one at the next).

snippets.title: Shaker
snippets.description: A 16th-note shaker with a soft accent pattern, quieter than you think.

snippets.title: Trap hat rolls
snippets.description: 8th hats that sometimes ratchet into triplets and 32nds (ply) for the trap flutter.

snippets.title: Conga groove
snippets.description: Picks different conga hits with n() so a plain 8th line sounds played.

snippets.title: 808 cowbell
snippets.description: A syncopated cowbell, sparse and quiet: a little goes a long way.

snippets.title: Tom fill every 4 bars
snippets.description: Three bars rest, then toms walk down high-mid-low: <...> picks one step per bar.
snippets.code: s("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ht ht mt mt lt lt lt lt]>").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.6)

snippets.title: Chopped break
snippets.description: A breakbeat stretched over 2 bars (loopAt) and cut into 16 slices you can rearrange.

snippets.title: Mridangam phrase
snippets.description: Strokes of the South Indian mridangam, named by their syllables.

snippets.title: Root 8ths
snippets.description: The chord root on every 8th, one root per bar: the simplest bass that always works.

snippets.title: Off-beat house bass
snippets.description: Bass only between the kicks, so the two never fight for the low end.

snippets.title: Rolling techno bass
snippets.description: Three 16ths after every kick with a slowly opening filter: the rolling bass of techno.

snippets.title: Reese
snippets.description: Detuned stacked saws (supersaw) under a low filter: the growling bass of jungle and dnb.

snippets.title: Sub bass
snippets.description: A pure sine an octave down: felt more than heard, so keep it simple and steady.

snippets.title: Plucky synth bass
snippets.description: A square-wave line with a fast filter envelope (lpenv) for a pluck on every note.

snippets.title: 303 line
snippets.description: A resonant saw (high lpq) whose cutoff sweeps with a slow sine: the classic acid squelch.
snippets.code: note("a1 [a1 a2] a1 c2 a1 [g1 a1] e2 a1").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(300, 2500).slow(8)).lpq(14).decay(0.15).sustain(0).gain(0.45)

snippets.title: Envelope squelch
snippets.description: Each note opens the filter with its own envelope; accents (louder gain) bite harder.

snippets.title: Distorted acid
snippets.description: Acid through distortion and a dotted delay for the rave version; distort adds level, so gain stays low.
snippets.code: note("a1 a1 a2 a1 c2 a1 e2 g2").s("sawtooth").lpf(perlin.range(400, 2000)).lpq(16).decay(0.12).sustain(0).distort(0.4).delay(0.25).delaytime(0.1875).gain(0.3)

snippets.title: House stabs
snippets.description: Short chord hits on the off-beats: chord() names the harmony, struct() places the stabs.
snippets.code: chord("<Am7 Dm7 F^7 Em7>").struct("~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ x").voicing().s("sawtooth").lpf(1800).decay(0.18).sustain(0).room(0.3).gain(0.3)

snippets.title: Lo-fi jazz chords
snippets.description: Extended chords (9ths, 13ths) on a piano, voiced smoothly with voicing(), softened with a low-pass.

snippets.title: Ambient pad
snippets.description: Slow attack and release turn a saw chord into a pad; a big room glues it.

snippets.title: Church organ
snippets.description: A pipe-organ sample playing whole-bar chords: sampled instruments take note() like synths.

snippets.title: Supersaw chords
snippets.description: Wide detuned chords with a filter that breathes: the trance and synthwave wall of sound.

snippets.title: Up-down arp
snippets.description: Scale degrees with n() and scale(): change the scale and the arp follows.

snippets.title: Chord arpeggio
snippets.description: arp() steps through the notes of each voiced chord in the order you write.

snippets.title: Kalimba pentatonic
snippets.description: A pentatonic scale has no wrong notes: let a line of 8ths and 16ths ripple on a kalimba.

snippets.title: Generative bells
snippets.description: irand picks a new scale degree each step, degradeBy drops some: never the same twice.

snippets.title: Square-wave melody
snippets.description: A four-bar tune, one bar per <...> step, on a chiptune-ish square wave.

snippets.title: Supersaw hook
snippets.description: A short hook on a detuned supersaw with delay: the festival lead.

snippets.title: Sax phrase
snippets.description: A sampled sax playing a blues phrase; the vcsl instruments respond to note() like synths.

snippets.title: Singing vibrato lead
snippets.description: Long notes with vibrato (vib = rate, vibmod = depth in semitones) so they sing.

snippets.title: Noise riser
snippets.description: Noise in 16ths whose high-pass and level climb with a 4-bar saw: the tension before a drop.

snippets.title: Vinyl crackle
snippets.description: Random clicks (crackle, density = clicks per sample) band-limited like an old record.

snippets.title: Crash every 4 bars
snippets.description: A crash on the downbeat of each 4-bar phrase marks the sections.

snippets.title: Tape hiss
snippets.description: Faint filtered pink noise under the mix: texture you notice only when it stops.
